content_units: Income after tax is   CAD 3,900  . Current spending totals   CAD 4,011  , so the budget is overspent by   CAD 111   and is   CAD 611 away   from the goal of saving   CAD 500   next month.
Category   Current (CAD)   Problem Level   Suggested Next Month (CAD)   Change (CAD)
Debt payment   280   Keep at least current   280   0
The main problems are the categories with the most flexibility and the biggest overspend:
-   Dining out (CAD 380)   is the clearest leak.
-   Shopping (CAD 310)   is too high for a savings-focused month.
-   Misc (CAD 260)   suggests spending is not tightly tracked.
-   Groceries (CAD 620)   is high and may overlap with dining-out habits.
-   Entertainment + subscriptions (CAD 286 combined)   can be trimmed without affecting essentials.
This corrected plan reaches   CAD 800 in savings  , which clears the   CAD 500 target   with a   CAD 300 buffer  .
- Cut dining out to   1 meal per week max   and move that money to savings first.
- Set a hard cap of   CAD 120   for shopping and pause non-essential purchases for 30 days.
- Reduce groceries to   CAD 500   by meal planning, store-brand buying, and limiting convenience items.
- Cancel or pause unused subscriptions and target   CAD 40 total  .
- Keep   misc   at   CAD 100 max   by labeling every unplanned purchase before spending.
